title: Phase 1 — autonomous continuous market collection
current_blockers: SPORTSCARDSPRO_TOKEN is absent in the fast-lane workflow runtime.
SPORTSCARDSPRO_CSV_URL is absent in the bulk-lane workflow runtime; bulk is optional for v1 acceptance.
SportsCardsPro commercial sharing approval is not configured; public persistence remains blocked until express written permission/commercial licensing exists.

steps.title: Make provider/credential state explicit
steps.operational_note: Fast-lane token state and commercial-sharing approval are separate activation gates.

steps.title: Add end-to-end collection verification
steps.operational_note: Live provider verification starts automatically when SPORTSCARDSPRO_TOKEN is configured.

steps.title: Add retry/backoff and concurrency-safe failure behavior
Compute health and add hourly watchdog

safety_guarantees: Operational telemetry is stored outside data/ and therefore does not participate in runtime-data fingerprints.
Provider current prices remain separate from realized-sale canonical EV.
Modeled values cannot auto-promote into canonical EV.
Extreme price movements are quarantined instead of silently entering observations.
Missing credentials are represented as stalled/blocked configuration, not as healthy collection.
A concurrent main update causes the market bot push to fail safely; it does not rebase a stale generated fingerprint.
SportsCardsPro-derived data cannot be persisted into the public BreakMetric repository unless explicit commercial sharing approval is configured.
